diagnosis: The endpoint queues a database backup job in the APScheduler runner using schedule_id without verifying that schedule.organization_id == current_user.organization_id. An unauthorized user can trigger resource-heavy backup jobs on arbitrary customer databases or dispatch them to preconfigured targets.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/backups/schedules/4820/trigger-now HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
